file.reason: Direct match; Tabler 'file' icon represents a generic file document

document.reason: File with text lines; Tabler 'file-text' represents a text document

pdf.reason: Tabler has a dedicated 'file-type-pdf' icon with PDF label, unlike Lucide

new-folder.reason: Folder with plus sign for creating a new folder

open-folder.reason: Direct match for open folder icon

archive.reason: Direct match for archive/box icon in the Document category

zip.reason: Tabler has a dedicated 'file-zip' icon for compressed files

unlink.reason: Direct match for broken chain/unlink icon

image.reason: Tabler uses 'photo' (not 'image') for the image/picture icon in the Media category

gallery.reason: No generic gallery/multiple-photos icon in Tabler. Only singular 'photo' exists; brand-google-photos is brand-specific and inappropriate

video.reason: Direct match for video camera icon

camera.reason: Direct match for camera/photo capture icon

camera-off.reason: Direct match for disabled camera icon with slash

volume.reason: Tabler 'volume' is the standard speaker icon representing audio on

volume-low.reason: Tabler 'volume-2' shows speaker with single sound wave arc, representing low/medium volume

mute.reason: Direct match for muted speaker icon

music.reason: Direct match for music note icon in the Media category

microphone-off.reason: Direct match for muted microphone with slash

podcast.reason: No generic podcast icon in Tabler. Only brand-specific icons exist (brand-apple-podcast, brand-google-podcasts) which are inappropriate for a generic concept

broadcast.reason: Center dot with radiating signal elements; closest match for broadcast/live concept. No dedicated broadcast or radio-tower icon exists in Tabler

crop.reason: Direct match for crop/trim tool icon

rotate.reason: Direct match for rotation icon; Tabler also has rotate-clockwise and rotate-2 variants

play.reason: Tabler prefixes media controls with 'player-'; standard play triangle

pause.reason: Tabler prefixes media controls with 'player-'; two vertical bars

stop.reason: Tabler has a dedicated 'player-stop' icon unlike Lucide which uses 'square'

skip-next.reason: Triangle with vertical bar pointing right for next track; Tabler uses 'forward' not 'next'

skip-previous.reason: Triangle with vertical bar pointing left for previous track

fast-forward.reason: Double triangle pointing right; Tabler's 'player-track-next' is the fast-forward double-chevron style. No generic 'fast-forward' icon exists

rewind.reason: Double triangle pointing left; Tabler's 'player-track-prev' is the rewind double-chevron style. No generic 'rewind' icon exists

shuffle.reason: Crossed arrows for shuffle/random; Tabler uses 'arrows-shuffle' naming

repeat.reason: Direct match for repeat/loop arrows icon in the Media category

record.reason: Dedicated record circle icon in Tabler's player icon set

brush.reason: Direct match for brush/paint tool in the Design category

pen.reason: Tabler's 'pencil' is the standard writing/drawing tool icon in Design category. Also considered 'ballpen' but pencil is more universally recognized for this concept

color.reason: Eyedropper tool for picking colors; direct match for color picker concept

eraser.reason: Direct match for eraser/clear tool in the Text category
